definitions.delta: r_t + gamma*V(s_{t+1}) - V(s_t); gamma read from the run's metadata
definitions.G: terminal WIN INDICATOR (1 win / 0 decisive loss) at gamma=1
definitions.buckets: early <=10, mid 11-24, late >=25 (game turn of the decision)
definitions.strata: bot = the 9 scripted bots; pool_sentinel = sentinel_0..4 (GREEDY-vs-STOCHASTIC handicap)
definitions.overdispersion: E[(V-y)^2] / E[V(1-V)]; 1.0 = the head's own stated confidence
definitions.murphy: Brier = REL - RES + UNC over 10 equal-count V-bins; UNC = base-rate cap
definitions.telescoping_caveat: sum_t delta_t = V(s_T) - V(s_0) inside a battle, so a pooled residual mean is dominated by the WIN/LOSS MIX of the captured sample. E[delta | V-level] is the confound-free read.
